## TalentFlow v2 — n8n + Data Tables
Only external service outputs are mocked. No in-browser database.
00 creates an isolated table. 10 contains all actions; 01–09 are optional separate endpoints.
Generate a private import copy with npm run setup:n8n. Publish 10.
Mock scores are demonstration-only; HR makes the final decision.
Single recruiter demonstration, not concurrent production hiring.
